evidence_quote: The powder from the Labinic synbiotic and Lab4b probiotic capsules was serially diluted and spread plated on MRS agars to obtain pure colonies, followed by culturing and genomic DNA extraction using FastDNA Spin Kit for Soil (MP Biomedicals) according to manufacturer’s instructions.
rationale: All 17 BioSamples of this deposit are pure cultures of the trial's probiotic strains (BioSample SAMN46435782/SAMN46435774: sample_type 'Pure culture', host 'not applicable', isolation_source 'not applicable', organism Bifidobacterium/Lactobacillus, package Microbe 1.0), and the paper's data availability states 'For the probiotic organisms, raw sequence reads (FASTQ) are available on the NCBI SRA as BioProject: PRJNA1165510'. The methods show the isolates were plated from the Labinic and Lab4b capsule powder, so geo_loc_name 'United Kingdom: Norwich' is where the capsules were cultured and sequenced (Quadram Institute Bioscience), not where a person was sampled. No person was sampled in this deposit, so no country of collection exists: retire rather than recode to KE. The Kenyan infants' stool metagenomes of this trial are not in this BioProject.
